svg.text: Architecture: AI/ML recommends · deterministic guardrails authorize · Razorpay Payment Links execute · verified webhooks update state
app/ + core/ · one decision authority: core/decision/decision_engine.py
EV(action) = P(recovery | context, action) × amount − action cost → choose max-EV feasible action
context fed to the model: amount · error code · prior successes ·
customer tenure · attempt number · hours since failure
Audit rows are written at DECISION, EXECUTION and OUTCOME — the whole flow is traceable.
offline/ + run_offline_pipeline.py · fully standalone (no server, no credentials)
models/recovery_model.pkl -> reused by the live decision path (provenance disclosed in every response)

Verified pipeline result: agent 79.4% vs baseline 57.2% recovery -> +22.22 pp absolute, +38.83% relative lift · net 848,380 (gross − discounts) vs 661,729 · 0 exceptions · Brier ≈ 0.197 · ROC-AUC ≈ 0.68 — simulation environment, not real-world rates.
Generated from the frozen RevLoop repository — every box maps to an actual module.
